blocks.text: Standard rhythm (60 minutes per day plus one session with the tutor): one line per week. Light rhythm: Each line lasts for two real weeks. Intensive rhythm: one line each 4 days about, with extra time reading and listening. Weeks 49–52 are the last of the first year; if the test A1 is not exceeded serve for recovery and the calendar A2 Four-week sleigh. Bearing weeks: 60, 69, 82, 91. The same rows, with the columns "Fatta" and "Note" are in the Excel file of the Layer A2.
